title: Home on Friday

beats.say: Hey committee, give me one reason to work from home on Friday.
beats.show: Hey committee. Give me one reason to work from home on Friday.

beats.say: Of course. Reason one, you focus better at home. Though, to be fair, not always.

screen.title: Re: Friday
screen.body: 1. You focus better at home (not always)

screen.body:
1. You focus better at home (not always)
2. No commute (boss may feel lonely)
3. Caveats, see below

screen.title: Re: Friday

Working from home on Friday.
Proof attached: in bed.

caption:
she needed one reason to stay home. the proof gave her boss one reason to say no.
